name: office-visibility
title: Show or hide controls on a custom ribbon tab
shortDescription: This sample shows how to set and change the visibility of groups and controls on a custom Office Add-in ribbon tab.
longDescription: This sample shows how to set initial ribbon visibility in the unified manifest and change group and control visibility at runtime with Office.ribbon.requestUpdate().
